name: Class Diagram — Domain Model E-Commerce
description: Class Diagram describes the static structure of the system through classes, attributes, methods, and relationships between them. This is the foundational diagram when designing the domain model for an e-commerce system.
purpose: Design the data structure for RDBMS systems through ORM and describe the Domain Model in DDD.
bestFor: Designing ORM entities for Spring Boot / Hibernate
Describing Domain Model in Domain-Driven Design
useCases: Define entities: User, Product, Order, CartItem, Category
Identify attributes and data types for each entity
Draw relationships: User 1→* Order, Order 1→* CartItem
requirements: REQ-001: Each User can have multiple Orders
REQ-002: Each Order belongs to a User and contains multiple CartItems
REQ-003: Each Product belongs to a Category
REQ-004: CartItem references Product and Order
REQ-005: User can have multiple shipping addresses

elements.name: User
elements.description: System user, has id, email, password

elements.description: Details of each product in the order
